study.aim: Measure whether distinct readers can find, correctly attribute and evaluate the 561 Group's environmental stewardship, climate adaptation, institutional-resilience, AI political-economy and crypto commons work, alongside retained agentics and mathematics baseline questions.
study.baseline: The 16 pre-existing version-2 queries remain byte-identical. The 15 new dated questions have no fabricated past measurements and are not included in earlier wave comparisons until an exact topic/query/surface/locale/mode matched observation is admitted.
study.comparison: Use branded/unbranded/control triads for each of five independent topics. Fix exact query wording, locale, geography, time window, platform, public source status and retrieval mode. Distinguish search-result visibility, AI-generated mentions and attributed citation URLs, Search Console index status, Bing AI-citation counts, referral and paid conversion.
study.stopRule: An answer absence or variant search result is not an index-exclusion diagnosis. Do not infer individuals' political or psychological beliefs, target climate fear, scrape private communities or label a drafted Science paper published. Negative/control results count. Rank or AI-citation claims require provider-specific independent evidence.
